entities.summary: Oleg Petrovich Korolyov is a Russian politician. He served as the Head of Administration of Lipetsk Oblast in Russia between 1998 and 2018. He became a member of the federation council in 1996. He was elected with a declared result of more than 70% of the votes cast. His administration has garnered praise for the authorities' treatment of its Jewish minority. Korolev met with chief rabbi of Lipetsk Shaul Adam on February 2, 2006; the rabbi reported on local radio that there had been no antisemitic incidents in Lipetsk Oblast.
